## Description

Implements step 3 of `group-investment-review`: the Korean Fair Trade Act Art. 47 related-party-transaction screen, run only when the deal involves affiliate transactions (sibling-entity deals within the same corporate group — the design's "group vs. entity" distinction, validated against a real intra-group case in `docs/pilots/pilot-003-doosan-bobcat-robotics.md`). Use when: "related party transaction", "Fair Trade Act Art. 47", "intra-group transaction", "affiliate transaction screen".
